about: How the hero was made. Nothing is modelled, textured or animated by hand or in code: the design is generated artwork, a sculpt is lifted from that artwork, dev/make_lowpoly.py turns the sculpt into the game-resolution model (simplify, unwrap, bake colour and detail), a rigging service gives it a skeleton and plays clips from its motion library on it, and dev/build_char.py packs the downloads for the game. Posture and single poses are then corrected in dev/animator.html (src/gfx/char-edits.js).
service: Higgsfield (images: GPT Image 2.6; sculpt: Tripo H3.1 image-to-3D; skeleton and clips: Meshy 3D rigging with a clip from its animation library)

design.prompt: Original game character key art: a chibi-proportioned young warden of a night forest, about two and a half heads tall, standing in a confident three-quarter pose and looking at the viewer with a calm, determined expression. Messy ash-grey hair with one ember-orange streak, large amber eyes, a deep midnight-blue hood pushed back onto the shoulders, a short asymmetric mantle of layered dark raven feathers over the left shoulder, fitted charcoal leather and blackened steel armor with fine brass filigree and small crescent-moon charms on thin chains, a wide belt with pouches and a small glowing brass lantern, tattered deep-blue waist cloth with pale stitched runes, armored gloves, sturdy buckled boots with brass toe caps. The right hand rests on the grip of a large curved single-edged greatsword planted point-down in front, its dark blade etched with glowing ember-orange runes and a thin line of living flame along the cutting edge. Setting: a torch-lit forest outpost at night, softly out of focus: a wooden palisade of sharpened stakes, barrels, a burning brazier, wet mud ground with a small puddle reflecting the fire, cool blue moonlit trees behind. Lighting: warm orange firelight from one side, cool blue rim light from the other. Style: highly detailed stylized 3D anime game render, chibi proportions, crisp materials, soft depth of field, rich colour. Full body visible from head to boots. No text, no logo, no watermark.

design.note: A clean model-sheet view made for sculpting: chunky shapes, even light, A-pose, closed fists. The first hero was lifted from a small three-view sheet and came out with a flat, mask-like face; one large front view gives the generator enough to sculpt the face and the outfit properly.
design.prompt: Game character model sheet, FRONT VIEW ONLY, of the SAME character as in the reference image, redesigned as a clean production 3D game character model in the style of a high-end anime action RPG. One single full-body figure, perfectly centred, facing the camera straight on, orthographic view, filling most of the frame from the top of the hair to the soles of the boots. Proportions: chibi, about 2.6 heads tall, large head, short sturdy limbs. Pose: neutral A-pose for rigging: standing upright and perfectly symmetrical, arms straight and held about 35 degrees away from the body, both hands closed in relaxed fists with thumbs pointing forward, legs straight, feet shoulder-width apart and pointing forward. Face: large clear amber anime eyes with clean dark lashes and bright highlights, thin eyebrows, small nose, small closed mouth, calm confident expression, smooth skin, ears visible. Hair: messy ash-grey hair made of large chunky smooth locks (no thin stray strands), with one ember-orange lock in the fringe on the viewer's left side. Outfit (keep the reference design but simplify fine detail into bold clean shapes): midnight-blue hood lying back on the shoulders with a pale stitched edge; a short mantle of a few large thick layered dark raven feathers over his left shoulder; fitted charcoal leather tunic with brass trim lines and one round brass clasp at the collar; wide brown belt with a big brass buckle, one chunky pouch on his right hip and a small brass lantern hanging close against his left hip; a deep-blue waist cloth hanging to the knees with a pale stitched rune pattern and a slightly ragged hem; dark trousers; brass-trimmed bracers on the forearms; sturdy dark boots with brass toe caps and two buckles. Hands are EMPTY: no sword, no weapon. No dangling chains, no floating pieces, nothing thin or wispy. Rendering: smooth clean surfaces, flat even colours with only soft simple shading, crisp clean colour boundaries, no dirt, no scratches, no noise, no painted cast shadows, no outline strokes. Soft even neutral studio lighting from the front, no shadow on the ground, plain flat light-grey background. No text, no labels, no other views.

Game weapon asset concept: the SAME curved greatsword the character holds in the reference image, shown alone. A large single-edged curved greatsword standing perfectly vertical with the point at the bottom and the grip at the top: dark steel blade with etched rune symbols glowing ember-orange and a bright orange glowing cutting edge, an ornate brass crossguard with a crescent-moon motif, a grip wrapped in dark leather, a small brass pommel with a short strip of tattered blue cloth. No flames, no fire, no smoke around it. Single isolated object, whole sword fully visible and centered with space around it, straight-on side view of the flat of the blade, plain flat light-grey studio background, soft even neutral lighting, no cast shadow, no hand, no character, no text. Stylized 3D anime game asset render, crisp detail.
design.note: Image-to-3D refused this picture three times (two services), and a sword is nearly flat anyway: dev/build_env.py lifts it straight from the painting (pack_relief), cutting away the tassel.

model.result: a sculpt of about 297,000 triangles with a 4096 texture; it faces +x
model.lowpoly: python3 dev/make_lowpoly.py sculpt.glb <dir>/hero --yaw -90 --head 1.8 --tris 45000  ->  lowpoly.glb (kept as dev/rig/hero.glb), albedo.png, normal.png
model.note: Compared with Hunyuan3D v3 (one view, and front + back) on the same image: Tripo kept the sheet's own face and colours and a clean back; Hunyuan repainted the eyes and hair. The rigging service needs the model to face +z: sent facing +x it put the skeleton in sideways.
